title: Anna's Trip
text:
Anna wants to visit her friend in another town. She looks at a map to find the way. The map shows the roads, the rivers and the train station. Anna finds the station and the street where her friend lives.

Next, Anna looks at the train timetable. The timetable shows the times of the trains. The train leaves at 9:15 in the morning. It arrives at the station at 10:30.

questions.text: What does Anna look at to find the way?
What time does the train leave?
Why does Anna look at the timetable?
options: She wants to know when to travel
She wants to buy a new map
She wants to visit the river
She wants to call her friend

questions.text: Which is probably true about Anna's trip?
options: She will not take a train
She will walk to the town
She will arrive in the morning

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows roads, rivers and places
a list that shows the times when trains or buses leave and arrive
a place where trains stop so people can get on and off

paragraph_translations: Анна хоче відвідати свою подругу в іншому місті. Вона дивиться на карту, щоб знайти дорогу. Карта показує дороги, річки і вокзал. Анна знаходить вокзал і вулицю, де живе її подруга.
Далі Анна дивиться на розклад руху потягів. Розклад показує час потягів. Потяг відправляється о 9:15 ранку. Він прибуває на вокзал о 10:30.
